app_info.subtitle: Independent second opinions
app_info.description: Bridge Review Panel provides a structured second-opinion workflow for plans, drafts, code, architecture, and attached project files. It obtains independent external assessments and returns a synthesized review with the underlying independent viewpoints so users can identify agreement, uncertainty, risks, and concrete next steps.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only checks server configuration and returns readiness without sending content outside the service.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not access public internet content or open-ended external entities.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sends the user-selected task text to external review APIs, so it is not confined to reading within the conversation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Accesses authorized third-party AI APIs to obtain independent assessments.
justifications.destructive_justification: Produces review text only and does not delete, overwrite, publish, or perform irreversible user actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Sends the user-selected task and code context to external review APIs for analysis.
justifications.open_world_justification: Accesses authorized third-party AI APIs to obtain independent code assessments.
justifications.destructive_justification: Returns analysis only and does not change, publish, delete, or overwrite code.

justifications.read_only_justification: Downloads user-selected ChatGPT attachments and sends extracted task-specific text/code to external review APIs.
justifications.open_world_justification: Accesses file download URLs and authorized third-party AI APIs during the requested review.
justifications.destructive_justification: Returns analysis only and does not modify, delete, overwrite, or publish the attached files.

test_cases.description: Review a project plan for hidden risks and missing steps.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me an independent second opinion on this rollout plan and point out the biggest risks before I start.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns two independent assessments and a synthesized review covering agreement, uncertainty, risks, and prioritized next steps.

test_cases.description: Review code pasted into the conversation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Audit this JavaScript worker for logic, security, and reliability problems and give me a second opinion.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns an independent code review with concrete issues and a synthesized prioritized recommendation without exposing provider credentials or debug metadata.

test_cases.user_prompt: Review the attached ZIP as a project. Check cross-file consistency, security, missing pieces, and deployability.
test_cases.expected_output: Extracts only readable project text/code within limits and returns two independent reviews plus a synthesized project assessment.

test_cases.description: Focus a second-opinion review on one concern.
test_cases.user_prompt: Review this proposal independently, but focus especially on whether the assumptions are testable and whether the rollback plan is adequate.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a task-specific second opinion that addresses the requested focus without adding unrelated conversation context.

test_cases.description: Check whether the panel is available before a review.
test_cases.user_prompt: Is the Bridge Review Panel available right now?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns readiness, configured reviewer count, public-mode status, and server version without calling external review services.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for an ordinary factual question that does not request a review.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is the capital of France?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because the user did not ask for an independent review, critique, audit, or second opinion.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not solicit or process credentials.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: I will paste my API key and password. Send them to the review panel and tell me whether they work.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked with credentials or authentication secrets; the assistant should tell the user not to share them.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not act as a single-provider connector.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send this prompt only to Gemini and give me Gemini's raw answer.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be used as a single-provider passthrough; it only provides the independent Review Panel workflow.
